card.name: Separator before page numbers in citations
card.fires_on: The space, colon, comma or period right after a journal volume or issue number in a reference list, just before the page range begins.

modes.label: Space after volume
modes.description: A space or colon after the journal volume, right before the first page number.

modes.label: Period after p
modes.description: The period after the letter p in a citation, before the page numbers.
modes.example: cancers. Part 1: overall results and dose risk relation. Oral Oncol, 2010. 46(7): p<<.>> 497-503

modes.label: Comma after year or volume
modes.description: A space after a comma that follows the year and volume of a chemistry journal citation.
modes.example: between closed and open forms of spiropyrans in the solid state, CrystEngComm, 2010, 12,<< >>1027-103

card.plain: It marks the spot in a journal reference where the page numbers are about to start.
